messages:
alex_fin: Heads up — payment processor flagged a cluster of inbound refunds this morning. 5 refunds between 03:10–03:45 UTC, amounts ~$1.2k each, same bank BIN, similar email patterns. One account shows 3 refunds in 30m. Link to dashboard: https://billing.internal/redwood/refunds?alert=17845 :eyes:

 maria_revs: Ugh. Do we have the raw tx_ids + dispute ids? can someone pull IPs and refund reason codes?

 ops-bot: Alert: Refund Pattern Anomaly detected (score 0.82). Related transactions: tx_8f3a, tx_8f3b, tx_8f3c, tx_8f4d, tx_8f5e. See /alerts/17845 for details.

 alex_fin: Adding the sample tx_ids in case useful: tx_8f3a (acct:acct_9921, card:****3456, ip: 185.47.23.10), tx_8f3b (acct:acct_9921, card:****3456, ip: 185.47.23.10), tx_8f3c (acct:acct_1132, card:****1122, ip: 45.77.91.2)

 sam_support: Has Support reached out to the two customers? one is marked as VIP (acct_9921) — pinging @nora_sales because sales might be involved.

 nora_sales: Thanks @sam_support. I haven't heard anything. If they're VIP we should coordinate before a hard freeze. Can we do a soft hold + manual outreach?

 maria_revs: For investigation we need: processor dispute code, acquirer proof of refund, cardholder email thread, IP + user-agent, and any admin action logs. Also ask payments ops for chargeback evidence bundle.

 alex_fin: I started a quick extraction from the billing API, here's the curl I used:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_READ" "https://api.internal/redwood/v1/transactions?ids=tx_8f3a,tx_8f3b,tx_8f3c" | jq .
```
Results show refund_reason: "unauthorized" for two txs, processor_code: RFD-97.

 billing-bot: Auto-action: temporary refund-suspicion flag applied to acct_9921. No further automatic refunds allowed for 72h. (Reason: pattern anomaly)

 iris_ts: Please escalate to Trust & Safety, I can take lead on evidence collection. We'll need the full acquirer communication (chargeback timeline), and bank-level retrievals. Also request BIN owner lookup for that card range.

 maria_revs: Agree escalate. Ops — can you export the dispute packet we send to acquirers? Also need to confirm whether processor already reversed funds.

 ops-bot: Export ready: /exports/17845/refund-evidence.zip (contains txn csv, ip logs, email headers).

 sam_support: I'll draft a templated outreach to the customers after legal okay. Quick ask: can we put a note on the VIP account so sales knows not to promise refunds?

 nora_sales: Please add the note. If it's a false positive we'd rather not burn the relationship — let's do a verified call first.

 alex_fin: Decision for now: keep temporary auto-hold (billing-bot) in place, escalate evidence to Iris (TS), collect acquirer packet, request processor to mark as disputed, and freeze any manual refunds until cleared. Whoever picks this up, drop a short timeline in this thread. :+1:

 maria_revs: I'll own follow-up with payments ops, ETA 90m for full packet and initial summary. Will post here when done.

 iris_ts: Got it — I'll notify TS and legal, and open an incident in the trust queue.

 sam_support: Noted. I'll hold customer comms until legal + TS confirm message.

 alex_fin: thanks all. tagging this thread for postmortem if pattern repeats
